title: 第576章 这些人穷疯了吧？！
content_zh:
“嘻嘻，”宴欢笑道：“掌教师弟怎这般说话，当年之事可怨不得我，谁曾晓得陆道友竟如此记仇，时至今日还耿耿于怀。”

“不就是借走了他父亲留下的遗物么，就记到今日。”

她眨着亮晶晶的杏眸，愉悦道：“他要是真缺少父母之爱的话，我可以充当那些缺失的角色来弥补他嘛，也留给他一柄飞剑。”

“我们找到了，这里可能就是古罗帝皇之墓了。”毒蛇扶着猎豹，看到如此空阔的墓室，不禁激动道。

倪多事不知邋遢老头儿将他带到这里是何意思，又看到这奇怪的易筋山，一脸迷茫的望着邋遢老头儿。

就连贵为破空境强者的拂尘都一脸赞同的点了点头，没有半点异样。

城外震天的战吼声一直持续了将近两个时辰，也终于停了下来，夏蒙消灭了叶邵元的所有势力，叶家之人也全部被抓了起来，此刻的冀州城，已经完全被夏蒙所掌握。

“哪有这么容易逃走！”易轩断喝一声，胸前五色印记同时闪亮，五只巨掌瞬间捉住逃走的五人，将他们牢牢捏在掌心，微微用力，马上传出鬼哭狼嚎般的惨叫。

杨富贵猛然惊醒，这才发现战斗已经结束，陆沉正站在他的身前，神色平静，看不出什么。

少年面容清秀，脸上无悲无喜，无比淡然，奇特的是，少年的身后站着一个道士，还有个富态的中年人，这三人正是言道人，溪柳村的柳长山，还有狗子又或者是……左君。

少年醉眼朦胧，口齿都开始不伶俐，左君摇头失笑，一葫芦本就不多，何况大半都入了自己腹中，自己没事，这找人喝酒的却成了这副样子。

应长老在他们心中，堪比神抵的存在，恶魔先生都能和对方战斗那么长时间，真厉害。

信天翁转了转脑袋，它很无奈，需知池榭鳴珂口中说的不相干的人正是他与龙宿的那些个后辈学海门人。

在一阵轻微的晃动后，安格斯所驾驶的这驾F-Ⅵ型太空梭已在停机坪内停泊完毕，而随着舱门的关闭，停机坪内的气压、氧气等等各项环境数据都调试完成。

尤其是雪莉尔，更像是一副见鬼的模样，不停的叫着，法师杀手这几个字。

倒不是说，那些大乘期强者如同废物，而是他们遭受修为封印之后，在影的困足式暗算之下，仓促期间根本躲不开洪巨的打击。

所有人都知道煤矿挣钱，于是很多人对此都是虎视眈眈的。对于倪凌薇说的她表哥手中的煤矿，林熹虽然没有细问，但料想这也和倪家有一定关系，否则他这个表哥应该不可能拿到煤矿的所有权的。

“停下？”鸠盘神子望着飞速冲向道魔战场的茶毗，心思莫名…本想勾起他之魔性，难道，却是助他恢复本我？

“哟西，大家注意，一定要确保任务成功。”鬼子中佐低声的喊道。

“恩，”绿蒂不解的眨了一下双眼，“为什么？”她奇怪的看着银飒就连穿衣服的动作都慢了起来，他们不是以前都是这样吗？

此时此刻，韩伟军真有一股挂靴而去的冲动，不过他却并没有那么去做，而是啪的一声，点上一支烟，坐在沙发上沉思了起来。

“呵。”少年有些尴尬的摸了一下自己的头，被人这样的无情的拒绝，还是第一次，他感觉自己的面子上真的是过不过去了。
content_en:
"Hee hee," Yan Huan said with a smile, "Why are you talking like this, Master Master? You can't blame me for what happened back then. Who would have known that Fellow Daoist Lu would hold a grudge so much, and he still feels so resentful to this day."

"Isn't it just that he borrowed the relics left by his father? I will remember it until today."

She blinked her bright almond eyes and said happily: "If he really lacks the love of his parents, I can play the missing role to make up for him, and also leave him a flying sword."

"We found it. This may be the tomb of the Ancient Luo Emperor." Viper supported Cheetah and couldn't help but said excitedly when he saw such an empty tomb.

Ni Duoshi didn't know what the sloppy old man meant by bringing him here. When he saw this strange Yijin Mountain, he looked at the sloppy old man in confusion.

Even Fu Chen, who was regarded as a strong man in the Sky-Breaking Realm, nodded in agreement, showing no signs of anything unusual.

The thundering war roar outside the city lasted for nearly two hours and finally stopped. Xia Meng eliminated all Ye Shaoyuan's forces, and all the Ye family members were arrested. At this moment, Jizhou City was completely controlled by Xia Meng.

"How can it be so easy to escape!" Yi Xuan shouted loudly, and the five-color marks on his chest flashed at the same time. Five giant palms instantly caught the five people who escaped, pinched them tightly in their palms, and with a slight exertion, screams like ghosts and wolves were heard.

Yang Fugui suddenly woke up and realized that the battle was over. Lu Chen was standing in front of him with a calm expression and nothing could be seen.

The young man had a delicate face, neither sadness nor joy, and was extremely indifferent. What was strange was that there was a Taoist priest standing behind the young man, and a rich middle-aged man. These three people were the Taoist, Liu Changshan of Xiliu Village, and Gouzi or... Zuo Jun.

The young man's eyes were hazy from drunkenness, and his speech was starting to become arrogant. Zuo Jun shook his head and laughed. A gourd was not much, not to mention that most of it went into his own belly. He was fine, but this person who was looking for someone to drink became like this.

In their hearts, Elder Ying is comparable to a god. Mr. Demon can fight with the opponent for such a long time, which is really amazing.

The albatross turned its head. It was helpless. You need to know that the irrelevant people Chi Xie Mingke mentioned were the people from Haimen who were his descendants and Longsu's disciples.

After a slight shaking, the F-VI space shuttle driven by Angus has been parked on the apron. With the door closed, the air pressure, oxygen and other environmental data in the apron have been debugged.

Especially Sheryl, who looked more like she had seen a ghost and kept shouting the words "Mage Killer".

It's not that those powerful people in the Mahayana stage are like waste, but that after they were sealed by cultivation, they were unable to avoid Hong Ju's blow in a hurry under Ying's trap-foot plot.

Everyone knows that coal mines make money, so many people are eyeing it.Although Lin Xi did not ask in detail about the coal mine that Ni Lingwei mentioned about her cousin, he guessed that it had something to do with the Ni family, otherwise it would be impossible for his cousin to obtain the ownership of the coal mine.

"Stop?" Jiuban Shenzi looked at Chapi who was rushing towards the battlefield of Dao Demon. He had an inexplicable thought... He wanted to arouse his demonic nature, but could it be to help him regain his true self?

"Yoshi, everyone, please pay attention and make sure the mission is successful." Lieutenant Colonel Japanese shouted in a low voice.

"Well," Lotte blinked in confusion, "Why?" She looked at Yin Sa strangely and even the movement of getting dressed slowed down. Weren't they always like this before?

At this moment, Han Weijun really had the urge to hang up his boots and leave, but he didn't do that. Instead, he lit a cigarette and sat on the sofa to meditate.

"Ha." The young man touched his head in embarrassment. This was the first time he was rejected so ruthlessly. He felt that he really couldn't survive in terms of face.
title_en: Chapter 576 Are these people crazy and poor?!
